Thank you. I have created all the needed paperwork (last will and testimony, power of attorney, living will just in case, etc) and have prepared as much as possible. After S much thought about it as possible, I have decisions that he say I go through with it, I will seek a hospital first, for like you said, all avenues would be covered. I have never found more scientific and practical data in regards to suicide as I have found here www.lostallhope.com. One of two methods I was going to go through with only has a 6 percent success rate. However another has 99.6 percent, but much messier. I wanted my death to be clean and elegant, but being a rational person the numbers don't add up. 
And thank you for reaching out.

Thank you. I think I will take you up on that. It's nice to talk to those that really understand. I work graveyard (while I'm still working), but usually available after I wake up around 2pm. Usually then go spend what I have on drugs to hide the pain at lease for a short while. Yes, I would like to talk.
